Prague local elections 2026

View

One dot = 10 voters who cast a valid city-council ballot, split by list vote share (each voter has up to 65 votes). Dots sit on residential buildings of the voters' precinct, at random within the building. allnone

Each precinct resized so its area matches the voters who cast a valid ballot there (400,413 in all). Neighbours stay neighbours; the base map is off because nothing here sits where it is on the ground.

Results: ČSÚ, volby.gov.cz (live feed, city-council ballot). Boundaries: ČÚZK RÚIAN, CC BY 4.0. Base map: Esri. Cartogram: cartogram-cpp (Gastner, Seguy & More 2018, with topology-preserving densification). Dots: RÚIAN residential buildings (ČÚZK). District figures are sums of their counted precincts. Precinct names: ČSÚ statistical units (ZSJ) and cadastral areas from RÚIAN. Area types: the Metropolitní plán structure of each precinct's housing (IPR Praha, CC BY 4.0) split by building age from RÚIAN; the rule for each type shows on hover.
